prompt:
Check one candidate model relation against the source sentences of a long document. The sentences come from different places in the document; unit ids show their order.

Candidate: Vessel AIS Receiver provides "a Position Quality Flag" to Fleet Dispatch Console (an information or material flow).

Source sentences:
S104: An onboard logger timestamps observations and retains a local history during intermittent communications.
S105: The Vessel AIS Receiver produces a Position Quality Flag when position integrity checks fail or confidence falls below its configured threshold.
S224: The Duty Planner updates work priorities when access conditions or resource availability change.
S225: The Fleet Dispatch Console uses the quality flag to support movement planning.

Answer "supported" only if the sentences state that Vessel AIS Receiver produces or sends this item AND that Fleet Dispatch Console receives or uses the same item (it may be named more briefly in one sentence). Answer "unsupported" if they describe different items, the wrong elements or the opposite direction. Answer "uncertain" if the text is not clear enough. Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
response: {"verdict":"supported","reason":"S105 says the Vessel AIS Receiver produces a Position Quality Flag, and S225 says the Fleet Dispatch Console uses the quality flag, which is the same item named more briefly, so the flow from receiver to console is supported."}
